result.reason: The operative language does not reach either playbook position. Although it adds the desired Vendor indemnity triggers, it does not require TrueLink to defend claims, does not clearly limit the indemnity to third-party claims, and includes no notice, control, or cooperation procedure. It also leaves Client’s indemnity substantially broader than the permitted Customer-content and breach-of-law scope. Nor does it satisfy the fallback, because it omits the customary IP exclusions, procure/modify/replace/refund remedies, and 3× annual-fees super-cap. The changes are otherwise targeted and preserve unrelated commercial terms, but the drafting retains an awkward duplicated 'harmless' construction and imprecise claim scope. The margin comment cannot cure these operative omissions.
